data.desc: Northrim is the holding company of Northrim Bank, an Alaska -based community bank with 21 branches throughout the state of Alaska. Northrim Bank differentiates itself with its detailed knowledge of Alaska's economy and its 'Customer First Service' philosophy. Northrim Funding Services, a division of Northrim Bank, operates a factoring and asset-based lending division in the State of Washington. Sallyport Commercial Finance, LLC, a specialty finance company, and Residential Mortgage, LLC, a regional home mortgage company, are wholly-owned subsidiaries of the Bank.
